topic: Learning to Use an EV Charger

script.title: LEARNING TO USE AN EV CHARGER
script.story_hook: My first time charging a brand-new electric car.
script.intro_zh: 第一次替嶄新的電動車充電。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today: learning the EV charger step by step.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天我們一步步學會電動車充電。
script.outro: Charging is easy once you know the words. Listen again and see you next time!
script.outro_zh: 學會這些詞，充電一點都不難。歡迎重聽，我們下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。

script.youtube_title: 【🔌🚙電動車充電英文】「先停止再拔線」怎麼說？18句新手充電站教學對話⚡｜EV Charging English
script.youtube_title_en: “Stop the App First” — Learning to Use an EV Charger
script.youtube_description:
剛買電動車，站在充電樁前不敢亂碰？這段18句的新手教學對話，教你用 App 啟動、插對連接槍、看懂燈號顏色、詢問每度電價格，還有安全拔線的正確順序。整段自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就敢自己充電。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
New EV and scared to touch the charger? This 18-line walk-through teaches you to start with the app, plug the connector in, read the light colors, ask about cost per kilowatt-hour, and unplug safely. Natural American English with IPA and translation, then repeat every line out loud in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🔌電動車充電英文｜App啟動・插槍連結・計價流程｜聽完就會充電｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次開電動車出門，充電樁到底怎麼用？
線插不進去、燈一直閃，該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進公路旁的充電站，新手司機在站務人員一步一步帶領下，從下載 App、輸入車牌、插上充電槍，到看懂燈號、詢問電價與安全收尾，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📱 啟動充電：例如「download the station app」、「enter your license plate, then tap start」。
🔌 插槍與燈號：例如「the cable won't click in」、「now the light is blinking blue」。
💲 問價錢：例如「what does this cost per unit?」、「thirty cents per kilowatt-hour」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

開著電動車慢慢練，下一站你自己就會充電！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a charging plug about to insert it

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I just got this electric car. Total beginner here.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ dʒʌst ɡɑt ðɪs ɪˈlɛktrɪk kɑr ˈtoʊtəl bɪˈɡɪnɪr hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我剛買了這輛電動車，完全是新手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to the club! Don't worry, it's easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛlˈkʌm tə ðə klʌb doʊt ˈwɜri ɪts ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎加入電動車家族！別擔心，很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, because I stared at this charger for ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt bɪˈkɔz aɪ stɛrd ət ðɪs ˈtʃɑrdʒər fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我對著這臺充電樁都發呆了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it happens to everyone. First, download the station app.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪt ˈhæpənz tə ˈɛvriˌwʌn fɜrst ˌdaʊnˈloʊd ðə ˈsteɪʃən æp/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，每個人都會這樣。先下載這個站的 App。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got the app. Then what? It asks for my plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ði æp ðɛn wʌt ɪt æsks fɔr maɪ pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: App 裝好了，然後呢？它問我車牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, enter your license plate, then tap start.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈɛntər jɔr ˈlaɪsəns pleɪt ðɛn tæp stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 對，輸入你的車牌號碼，再按開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, um, the cable won't click in.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm ðə ˈkeɪbəl woʊnt klɪk ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好的，呃，這連接線怎樣都卡不進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it slightly, then push straight. Feel that click?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ˈslaɪtli ðɛn pʊʃ streɪt fil ðæt klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 稍微轉個角度，再直直推進。有喀嚓一聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! It clicked. Now the light is blinking blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt klɪkt naʊ ðə laɪt ɪz ˈblɪŋkɪŋ blu/
dialogue.zh: 有了！喀嚓了。現在燈在閃藍光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it's charging. Green means full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪts ˈtʃɑrdʒɪŋ ɡrin minz fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 那就代表正在充電。綠燈就是充飽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Um, what does this cost per unit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ʌm wʌt dʌz ðɪs kɔst pər ˈjunɪt/
dialogue.zh: 了解。呃，這裡一度電要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About thirty cents per kilowatt-hour here.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈθɜrti sɛntərz pər ˈkɪloʊwɑt aʊr hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡一度大約三十美分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheaper than gas, honestly. How long should I wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃipər ðæn ɡæs ˈɑnəstli haʊ lɔŋ ʃʊd aɪ weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 老實說比加油便宜。我應該等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To eighty percent, maybe forty minutes. Grab a coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈeɪti pərˈsɛnt ˈmeɪbi ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnəts ɡræb ə ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 充到八成大概四十分鐘。去喝杯咖啡好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please! Can I just unplug when I'm back?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz kæn aɪ dʒʌst ʌnˈpluɡ wɛn aɪm bæk/
dialogue.zh: 好啊！回來的時候直接拔線就可以了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop the app first, and never pull the cable.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ði æp fɜrst ænd ˈnɛvər pʊl ðə ˈkeɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 先用 App 停止充電，千萬不要硬拉線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. Thanks, you made this way less scary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndərˈstʊd θæŋks ju meɪd ðɪs weɪ lɛs ˈskɛri/
dialogue.zh: 記住了。謝謝你，這下子一點都不可怕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Come back and tell me how it goes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm kʌm bæk ænd tɛl mi haʊ ɪt ɡoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！下次來再告訴我你用得怎麼樣。
